decisions.reason: Because the yogurt remained on the website through 2024 and fits the firm's trusted biodynamic dairy core, its performance appears at least near aspiration and uncertainty is low enough to retain it.

As a very new 2024 launch closely tied to the firm's established cheese capabilities in a growing market, management would likely use available slack to give this sliced cheese more time rather than drop it prematurely.

This sliced butter cheese is also a 2024 line extension close to the firm's core offer, so under bounded rationality and with no clear sign of failure yet, it would likely be kept while management learns about its market acceptance.
